jobs.description: Keemart is Meituan's self-operated on-demand retail business in overseas markets. It first launched in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, in May 2025, offering rapid delivery of groceries and daily essentials within 20 minutes . The Store Manager is primarily responsible for the operation and management of an individual service station. The average area of a service station ranges from 700 to 1,000 square meters, housing approximately 6,000 SKUs. While the daily order volume varies by city, it generally exceeds 1,000 orders per day. Therefore, the manager must possess effective methods for training and performance-based selection to improve employee retention and promotion rates. Warehouse Management， The front warehouse (service station) handles daily inbound shipments and returns from the main warehouse. Furthermore, after the service station commences operations, the manager must oversee the real-time allocation of tasks for order picking, packing, and fulfillment to ensure goods are delivered within the promised timeframe, and that order accuracy and product quality are maintained. Customer Complaint Management， Daily customer complaints primarily concern product quality issues, discrepancies between ordered and received items, and delivery timeliness.
